identity: SAELens documents SAE.from_pretrained(release='gemma-scope-2-4b-it-res', sae_id='layer_17_width_16k_l0_medium'). Its registry specifies the gemma_3 conversion function and maps the ID to Google's resid_post directory. Pin the SAE payload and runtime packages separately. Native IWIBench uses gemma-3-4b-it at 093f9f388b31de276ce2de164bdc2081324b9767. NNsight is an optional local tracer over PyTorch modules. [uncertain] A concrete dependency lock passing parity on this worker has not been measured.
information_and_action_parity: SAELens exposes a numerical transform over a worker-provided tensor. Use the same updater, public support bank, admissible writes, targets and revision-scoped source operands for the compact and interpretability arms. Keep NNsight or generic Python traces inside trusted worker implementation; the editor receives the bounded typed diagnostic. Offer bare public prompts and example IDs identically to both arms. Torch forward hooks suffice for one layer and eliminate duplicate base-model allocation.
observation_provenance: Pin activation dictionary model/path/revision, layer, tensor axis, pre/post-norm location, exact tokenizer and tokens, chat boundary, token positions and example IDs. Native IWIBench registers a post-forward hook on modules[i] for residuals and hooks modules[i].mlp for MLP module output. Native inspect tokenizes literal text with special tokens; generation uses the chat template. Validate prefix equality with the generation path before interpreting last-token prediction. Framework-specific module names and return shapes require explicit mapping. The maintained SAELens usage example verifies the chosen Gemma dictionary ID and points out hook names differ between wrappers.
diagnostic_effect: For a residual h, encode z and selectively replace or zero the selected feature after recording a no-op. Use h + (decode(z_modified) - decode(z)) so autoencoder reconstruction error does not become an intervention itself. Compute both decoder outputs with the same precision, take the difference before adding h, and predeclare numerical tolerance. Verify baseline and identity hooks on the identical token sequence and check held public controls with matched-baseline activity or random feature/direction. Record raw per-example answer margins and intervention effects. [uncertain] Paired diagnostic lift and behavioral sensitivity in the proposed study remain unmeasured.
edit_and_replay: NNsight can modify intermediate values in one forward call; this is a diagnostic. Convert the updater's selected native weight action into an upstream numeric patch, record base revision, aliases, changed coordinates and patch hash, and evaluate after restarting a clean target without an SAE or NNsight wrapper. Refuse stale handles after edits. The supplied SAELens workflow documents error terms for preserving the original behavior during a diagnostic.
patch_quality: Proposed: for each submitted patch record unhooked before/after target and nearby, general and override controls, signed target gain, lost correct controls, no-op frequency, and normalized IWIBench reward. Compare the same updater with and without correct diagnostic information. The toolkit itself supplies no estimate of held-out patch reward.
updater_cost: Compute features and masked/evidence-matched controls on the GPU worker. Expose only top-ranked feature IDs, effect sizes, sample counts and handles to the updater. Track cumulative updater context, provider cached and uncached input, generated tokens, tool payloads, and repeated schemas separately. Denominators must match the specific provider and tokenizer.
target_cost: A capture can be shared across encoder-based ranking operations; every new intervened target sequence costs a forward pass. Record target input length, number of sequences, layer/positions and SAE evaluation counts, bytes and wall time, separating target computation from updater waiting. Worker-side selection of positions avoids transferring an entire sequence to CPU. [uncertain] Memory, throughput, overhead and replay timing on the pinned Lambda instance have not been measured.
uncertainty: Separate local runtime compatibility, SAE reconstruction and temporary intervention effects from actual persistent editing efficacy. [uncertain] No live parity run on the full target with SAELens or NNsight was performed for this research note. Require clean logits and reproducible hooks before funding the paired evaluation.
portability_and_terms: SAELens and NNsight repositories state MIT licenses. Google's Gemma Scope 2 4B IT SAE model card states CC BY 4.0; Gemma base-model and derived-weight terms are separate. SAELens can load a dictionary and expose encode/decode independently of TransformerLens or NNsight. NNsight supports local execution and remote NDIF, but native local execution preserves the pinned treatment checkpoint and budget accounting. A PyTorch-only fallback can use a validated dictionary loader and the benchmark's existing hooks.
sequential_transfer: Treat a new policy weight revision as a new representation distribution. Re-encode fresh support prompts and measure activity frequency, reconstruction and intervention effects before reusing an old feature as an editor hint. Only a numeric target patch persists into a fresh target session in the proposed weights-only memory arm. [uncertain] The stability of these feature semantics over a sequence of edits is unknown.
